images.section_title: Introduction to Definition of Continuous-Time Convolution
images.image_description: A clean LTI-system block diagram showing an input signal x(t) decomposed into infinitesimal weighted impulse contributions x(tau) d tau. Each weighted impulse passes through an LTI system block labeled impulse response h(t), producing a shifted impulse response h(t-tau). Arrows from several shifted responses accumulate into the output y(t). Use simple labels, sparse annotations, and no numerical signal plots.

images.section_title: Introduction to Flip-Shift-Multiply-Integrate Procedure
images.image_description: A clean four-stage schematic over a horizontal tau-axis using one simple finite-duration input signal x(tau) and one simple finite-duration impulse response h(tau). Show the original input x(tau), the flipped response h(-tau), the shifted flipped response h(t-tau) for one fixed positive value of t marked as fixed, the product signal x(tau)h(t-tau), and an arrow from the shaded product area to y(t). Include an integral arrow labeled int_{-infty}^{infty} dot d tau. The visual should show procedure order only and should not evaluate the integral.
